name: CSO_DB_TOPIC
description: This table contains the discussion topic records.

columns.name: ACTUAL_RATING
columns.description: Actual rating for the topic record.

columns.name: CLOSED
columns.description: Flag indicating that the record was closed. Values 0-Open, 1-Closed.

columns.name: DATE_ADDED
columns.description: This is the datetime that the record was added to the repository.

columns.name: DATE_MODIFIED
columns.description: Datetime record was last modified in repository.

columns.name: REDIRECT_EXPIRY_DATE
columns.description: Datetime the topic redirect will expire.

columns.name: REDIRECT_TOPIC_ID
columns.description: This is the GUID reference to the redirected topic

columns.name: FORUM_ID
columns.description: This is the GUID reference to the forum record.

columns.name: IP_ADDRESS
columns.description: IP Address from which the request was made to create this record.

columns.name: LOCALE_ID
columns.description: This is the GUID reference to the locale record.

columns.name: MODERATE
columns.description: Flag indicating that the record needs moderation. Values 0-false, 1-true.

columns.name: PUBLISHED
columns.description: Flag indicating that the record is published or not. Values 0-false, 1-true.

columns.name: RECORD_ID
columns.description: This is the primary key of the table.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Flag that indicates the status of the topic record. Values 0-Asnwered, 1-Helpful, 2-Solved.

columns.name: TITLE
columns.description: This is the title for the topic record.

columns.name: TYPE
columns.description: Flag that indicates the type of the topic record. Values 1-Normal, 2-Question, 3-Announcement.

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: This is the obsolete GUID reference to the user record that created the record.

columns.name: USER_NAME
columns.description: Full name of user record that created the record.

columns.name: USER_NICKNAME
columns.description: Nickname of user record that created the record.

columns.name: WEIGHTED_RATING
columns.description: Weighted rating for the topic record calculated using the Bayesian Formula. The idea is that the more the votes, the more representative the average rating is.

columns.name: USER_PARTY_ID
columns.description: This is the ID of the user that created the record.
